curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what to do after hitting an animal, the first rule of any emergency, and brake failure in manual and automatic cars.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for manual versus automatic brake failure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on animal strikes and failed brakes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach drying wet brakes, using a low gear on long downhills, and handling a stuck gas pedal.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for using versus sparing brakes and stuck throttle versus failed brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on brake and pedal problems.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain warning signs and blowouts, how to respond to a blowout, and the safe steps for changing a flat or getting repairs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for the blowout response versus the tire change.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on blowouts and changing a flat.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover getting off the road and out of the car, signaling for help, and keeping a flashlight or flares.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for the help signal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to do after a breakdown.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach responding to an oncoming car in your lane and recovering after running onto the shoulder.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step; a contrast card for the two situations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on shoulder recovery and head-on threats.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain skid-prone surfaces, braking with and without ABS, steering into a skid and steering back.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for ABS braking and the two steering moves.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on avoiding and correcting skids.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover avoiding a head-on crash, a rear impact, bracing for impact, and the legal protection for those who help.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each action; a contrast card for a rear impact.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on last-moment crash actions.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the duty to stop, scene safety, moving cars off the lane, reporting rules and penalties, insurance, and exchanging information.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each duty; a contrast card for police versus insurer reporting.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on duties after a crash.
